result.note: Neighbors: cells whose centers lie within the radius. Expected: the labels shuffled among the cells of each slice. z > 0: the two groups sit together more often than their sizes imply; z < 0: they avoid each other; the diagonal is how clustered a group is. Co-localization suggests, not proves, interaction: a shared layer or compartment also brings cells together.
enrichment = log2(observed / expected if the two groupings were independent)

p-values treat cells as independent and are tiny for large groups: rank by AUC and fold change, and with several slices trust changes seen in every slice. Imaging panels pick up transcripts of neighboring cells (segmentation spillover): genes of the cell types around a group can appear as its DE genes.

DESeq2 (PyDESeq2) on pseudobulk counts: the raw counts of each side summed per slice, paired by slice. The replicates carry the statistics: with 2 per side few genes are trustworthy, 3 or more are better. Imaging panels pick up transcripts of neighboring cells (segmentation spillover), as in DE genes.

result.note: Co-expression of a ligand and its receptor in neighboring cells suggests, not proves, signaling (protein levels, processing and activity are not measured). Small panels hold few complete pairs. Transcripts of neighbors picked up by segmentation (spillover) can make a cell look like it expresses a ligand or receptor.
